raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY:
Software Developer with 4+ years of IT Experience and hands-on experience on ServiceNow platform as Developer in designing, developing, and ServiceNow ITSM, CSM, Knowledge, Service Request management, Virtual Agent, Service Portal, Predictive Intelligence, Automation, and Now Assist Solutions (OOTB Skills activation). Proven ability to automate processes, improve service efficiency, and deliver high-quality solutions aligned with business needs.
raw_sections.skills:
SKILLS:
ServiceNow CSM & ITSM: Case Management, Knowledge Management, Omni- channel Customer Engagement (Web Portal, Email, Chat, SMS), Reporting & Analytics, Now Assist for CSM & ITSM.
ServiceNow Platform: Workflow Editor, Flow Designer, Reporting & Analytics, Scripting (JavaScript, Glide), Business Rules, UI Policies, UI Actions, Integrations.
Processes: Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management (from a customer perspective), CSM Case Management, Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
Tools: Microsoft Office Suite, CRM Systems, Ticketing Systems. • Methodologies: ITIL, Agile/Scrum.
raw_sections.experience:
EMPLOYMENT DETAILS:
Worked as Senior software engineer at Infosys BLR from July 2022 to Mar 2026
Currently Working as ServiceNow Application Developer with Autonomize AI since MAR 2026 to
till now.
PROJECT SUMMARY:
Modules: CSM & ITSM Implementation and Enhancing ITSM and CSM modules
• •
Implementation and activation of OOTB Now Assist Skills for CSM and ITSM modules. Implemented Case, Account and Contact Management for B2B Model. Implemented Omni-channel to customer engagement via Live Agent Chat, SMS, Web and Email.
Contributed to ServiceNow platform architecture and roadmap initiatives, translating business requirements into scalable enterprise solutions and supporting platform enhancements across ITSM and CSM.
Designed and implemented enterprise-level ServiceNow integrations, including bi- directional integrations with LogicMonitor and SAP CRM using REST APIs, Import Sets, Transform Maps, Script Includes, OAuth 2.0, and event-driven architecture. Implementation of Inbound Email Flow to create Case, Incident and Generic Service Request Submission via Email.

ServiceNow development experience across ITSM and CSM, with expertise in Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, Script Includes, JavaScript/Glide, Flow Designer, Service Portal, and Catalog Item development.
Experienced in designing and implementing ServiceNow integrations and automation, including REST integrations, Import Sets, Transform Maps, Script Includes, OAuth 2.0, and event-driven architecture with external systems such as LogicMonitor and SAP CRM.
Contributed to ServiceNow platform roadmap and strategic planning, aligning platform enhancements and new capabilities with business requirements and long-term IT service objectives.
Supported prioritization of ServiceNow enhancements and automation initiatives, evaluating business needs and driving continuous improvements across ITSM and CSM modules.
Configuring and customizing the Case Management as per the business requirement. • Implementation ITSM modules, like Incident, Change and Problem management. • Implementation of Knowledge management. • Implementation of CSM and SP Service Portal from scratch. • Implemented Virtual Agent Chatbot with enhanced OOTB topics. • Enhanced the customer self-service portal by adding new features and improving


usability, resulting in a 25% increase in self-service adoption. Integration with Monitoring Tool to automate incident creation for Logic Monitor and later with Edwin AI (an AI product of Logic Monitor) Integration with SAP CRM tool to automatically creation of Case from Service Now Incident record.
Catalog Item development to enable the process for Tool Access Request, Lock out


users, Group Membership within ServiceNow and many more. Implemented automated case routing based on customer demographics and issue type, reducing case assignment time by 30%. Implementation of Predictive Intelligence for Classification of Category, Subcategory, Configuration Item and other field on Case and Incident.
Hands on experience to work on Service Now major upgrades and working on Skipped records, testing and fixing the issues.
MAJOR PROJECTS:
Project#1: Integration Platform Environment: ServiceNow & Logic Monitor Role: Software Engineer Overview: Bi-Directional integration project which allow third party monitoring tool. i.e. Logic monitor to create and update the incident in ServiceNow and ServiceNow agent to resolve and closed the ticket record from ServiceNow incident record. Responsibilities:
Designed and implemented integration between ServiceNow Incident module and Logic Monitor tool for automated incident creation from Logic Monitor and updating the record from both the sides.
Developed Import set table and transform map to handle incident creation/updation via
•

Import Set API. Implemented event-driven architecture using Event Registry and Script Actions. Implemented outbound REST message to update record in Logic Monitor from ServiceNow. Implemented Import Sets, Transform Maps, field mappings, transformation scripts, business rules, script includes, REST Message, OAUTH 2.0.
Project#2: Integration Platform Environment: ServiceNow & SAP CRM Role: Software Engineer
Overview: External system integrations to improve operational efficiency and cross-platform visibility. Responsibilities:
Designed and implemented integration between ServiceNow Incident module and SAP CRM for automated Case creation.
Developed custom UI Action “Create SAP Case” to trigger case creation from Incident form. • • Built Script Includes to construct payload and invoke SAP web service. • Captured SAP Case ID from response and stored it in a custom field on Incident for cross- system traceability.
Implemented event-driven architecture using Event Registry and Script Actions.
Eliminated manual SAP case creation effort and improved process efficiency. • Implemented Import Sets, Transform Maps, field mappings, and transformation scripts.
Project#3: Omni-Channel Customer Engagement Environment: ServiceNow, Email, Twilio for SMS Role: Software Engineer Overview: Setting up the Omni Channel support for customer to reach out to the GSD agents to resolve queries and issue using various channels like portal, email, and SMS. Responsibilities:
Designed and implemented Virtual Agent Live Agent Chat for portal to resolve customer queries.
Designed and implemented Email Inbound Action to create CSM Case, Incident and Generic Service Request via different email addresses.
Designed and implemented SMS channel via Twilio for customer to reach out to GSD agent via SMS directly from their mobile phones. This required integration with Twilio using Twilio Spoke and Conversational Interface via Twilio plugins. Implementation of Interaction Management to handle interactions from different channels like Chat and SMS. Implementation of Advanced Work Assignment and Queue for different regions.


Project#4: Now Assist Skills Environment: ServiceNow Role: Software Engineer Overview: Activation of OOTB Now Assist skills under ITSM and CSM for Incident Summarization, Case Summarization, Change Risk Explanation, Sentiment Analysis and few more. Responsibilities:
Activated and configured pre-built Now Assist Skills on Incident Management like Sentiment Analysis, Incident Summarization etc.,
Activated and configured pre-built Now Assist Skills on Case Management like Case Summarization etc.,
Activated and configured pre-built Now Assist Skills on Change Management like Change Risk Explanation etc.,
Project#5: Notification Revamp Overview: Implemented and enhanced an enterprise ITSM platform with advanced notification standardization. Responsibilities:
• Revamped Incident notification framework by designing a reusable Email Layout with
standardized header (Company Name, Module Name) and structured footer (signature, helpdesk contact details).
Developed centralized Email Templates and linked them with common layout to ensure consistent look and feel across all Incident notifications.
Reduced redundancy and improved maintainability by consolidating multiple notifications into standardized reusable templates.
